seatedToss.guidance: Mwicare ku meza, mukinane mugerageza gutera igikapu cyoroshye cy’ibinyampeke mu kibaho kinini. Mugumane igenamubare ku rupapuro, muri kumwe.
steps: Mucapure intego n’urupapuro rw’igenamubare, maze mubishyire hasi ku meza hagati yanyu.
Mwicare neza, umwe ku ruhande rumwe n’undi ku rundi. Buri muntu atera rimwe gahoro, cyangwa arekere aho niba adashaka.
Iyo igikapu kiguye mu mpeta, uwagiteye ashyiraho akamenyetso kamwe mu kazu kari ku murongo w’iyo mpeta, mu nkingi ye.
Iyo muhagaze, mushobora kureba hamwe ibimenyetso niba mubishaka. Nta muntu usabwa kubara ikintu na kimwe.
Muhagarare igihe cyose umwe muri mwe abyifuje.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Koresha igikapu gifite agashashi gafunze cyangwa isogisi yuzuye, wicare, ntugatere igikapu mu maso y’umuntu, kandi hari umukuru hafi. Ibintu bito bishobora gufatisha umuntu umuhogo.
flags: Ntibikwiye abari munsi y’imyaka 3: ibintu bito
safety: Hitamo igikapu cy’ibinyampeke gifite agashashi gafunze, cyangwa uzinge isogisi isukuye. Mbere y’uko ugikoresha, reba niba nta mwobo cyangwa udodo rurekuye, kugira ngo nta cyuzuza kizasohoka.
Ibinyampeke n’ibindi bintu bito byuzuza bishobora gufatisha umuntu umuhogo. Bibe kure y’abana bato n’umuntu wese ushyira ibintu mu kanwa.
Mugume mu bunani bw’ukuboko kandi mukurikirane hafi niba hari ikintu gishobora gushyirwa mu kanwa.
Mugume aho mwicaye. Mutere buhoro kandi hasi ugana ku ntego iri ku meza, ntugatere mu maso y’umuntu.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Urupapuro rwacapwe: intego y’impeta eshatu zitwa Hafi, Hagati na Kure, uhereye hanze ugana imbere, n’igenamubare rifite inkingi ya buri muntu n’umurongo w’utuzu tubura buri mpeta.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Shyira urupapuro hasi hagati yanyu. Iyo igikapu kiguye mu mpeta, shyiraho akamenyetso mu kazu k’inkingi yawe, ku murongo w’iyo mpeta.

coloringWall.previewCaption: Ishusho irimo imirongo y'impapuro n'ibirango bishushanyijeho.
coloringWall.labelsNote: Inyuguti zigenda ku rukuta uhereye hejuru ukamanuka, naho imibare igenda ku rukuta uhereye ibumoso ugana iburyo, bityo A1 ni impapuro iri hejuru ibumoso.
steps: Capisha impapuro zose. Impapuro ya mbere irimo aya mabwiriza n'ikarita y'urukuta.
Umuntu wese afata impapuro imwe cyangwa nyinshi akazisiga irangi.
Amabara n'uburyo bwo gushushanya ntibigomba kuba bimwe. Impapuro zose ni igice cy'ishusho imwe.
Shyira impapuro ukurikije ibirango byazo, hanyuma uzihuze ukoresheje ikaramu y'uburata inyuma yazo.
Shyira urukuta ahantu hose abantu bose bashobora kurureba.

coloring.guidance: Kanda ku ibara, hanyuma ukande ku gice cy'ifoto.

conversationCards.guidance: Musomere ikarita mu ijwi riranguruye. Nta bisubizo bitari byo bibaho.
conversationCards.groupSit: Mwicare mu ruziga aho buri wese abona ishusho. Umuntu ufashe ikarita, cyangwa igikoresho gifite ishusho nini, asoma igitekerezo hejuru mbere.
conversationCards.groupPass: Hanyuma uhe ikarita undi muntu. Buri wese avuga ijambo cyangwa interuro ku ishusho, hanyuma ayihereze undi.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Guhererekanya ikarita buri gihe biremewe. Umuntu ashobora kureka atavuze, kandi nta muntu usabwa gusobanura impamvu.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Umukino urangira igihe ikarita imaze kuzenguruka uruziga rwose, cyangwa igihe itsinda ryanyuzwe. Nta wutsinze. Muhagarike igihe cyose itsinda rishaka.

photoPairs.guidance: Kanda ku ifoto, hanyuma ukande ku isa nayo.
photoPairs.intro: **Hitamo amafoto kuva kuri 2 kugeza kuri 6** kuri iki gikoresho. Agaragara gusa kuri uru rupapuro kandi ntashyirwa kuri murandasi cyangwa ngo abikwe.
photoPairs.empty: Amafoto yawe azagaragara hano, buri rimwe ryikubye kabiri.

pictureBingo.guidance: Banza usohore amakarita mu mpapuro. Hanyuma werekane iki gikoresho cyo guhamagara kuri ecran nini ufite.
pictureBingo.start: Kanda "Ifoto ikurikira" kugira ngo uhamagare ifoto ya mbere.
pictureBingo.cardsLegend: Umubare w'amakarita yo gusohora mu mpapuro

print.one: Sohora ikarita {n} ya bingo mu mpapuro
print.other: Sohora amakarita {n} ya bingo mu mpapuro

calmBreathing.guidance: Shyira umwuka mu gihe uruziga rwaguka, hanyuma ukuremo umwuka mu gihe rugabanuka. Uruziga rwiyahagarika wenyine nyuma y'ihumeka esheshatu.
calmBreathing.finished: Ibyo byari ihumeka esheshatu ritinze. Ongera utangire igihe cyose ubishakiye.

storyChain.guidance: Musimburane: interuro 1 buri wese, mwongereho ishusho ikurikiyeho.
storyChain.passNote: Vuga interuro yanyu hejuru. Nta kintu kyandikwa cyangwa ngo kibikwe. Umuntu wese ashobora kurenga igihe cye.
storyChain.full: Urunyororo rufite amashusho yose 8. Mubwire inkuru yose, cyangwa mutangire urundi runyororo.

pictures.pine-cone-bird-feeder: Ikibindi cy'inyoni gikozwe mu mbuto y'igiti cya pine, cimanitse ku ishami
pictures.buttons-in-muffin-tin: Utubuto twatondetse mu kibindi cyo gutekeramo
